final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses, AVG(address_count) AS average_addresses_per_city FROM city_counts) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count * 1.0 / average_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average, address_count * 1.0 / total_addresses AS address_share FROM city_counts CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY address_share DESC LIMIT 10
